title: Kalshi and WellSpace Health announce $3 million partnership to expand access to healthcare in Sacramento
summary: Multi-year partnership will bring mobile breast cancer screening to underserved communities and support the development of a new regional healthcare campus.
body_markdown:
Kalshi, the federally regulated prediction market, and WellSpace Health, a nonprofit community health system serving the Sacramento region, today announced a three-year, $3 million partnership to expand access to essential healthcare services for underserved communities across Northern California.


The partnership will support two major initiatives: the launch of a mobile mammography program to bring breast cancer screenings directly to underserved communities and the development of WellSpace Health's new Community Wellness Campus, a 13-acre healthcare facility designed to expand access to comprehensive medical, dental, behavioral health, and supportive services.


WellSpace Health currently serves approximately 1,400 patients each day, many of whom are uninsured or rely on Medi-Cal. As healthcare providers across California face growing demand for affordable care, the partnership will help WellSpace Health reach more patients and strengthen its ability to serve communities that have historically faced barriers to essential healthcare.


"At Kalshi, we've always believed that building something meaningful means investing in the communities around us," said Tarek Mansour, Kalshi CEO and Co-Founder. "Access to quality healthcare shouldn't depend on someone's circumstances. WellSpace opens its doors to Californians every single day, and we're proud to help bring their services to more people. The partnership proves that innovation and philanthropy go hand in hand."


The partnership reflects Kalshi's broader commitment to investing in communities and expanding access to essential services. It follows the company's recently announced


[$3 million partnership](https://news.kalshi.com/p/kalshi-housing-works-partnership)


with Housing Works in New York City to expand healthcare access, workforce development, and community services; its partnership with the


[Public Housing Community Fund (PHCF)](https://nychajournal.nyc/new-funding-for-the-nycha-health-corps/)


in New York City; and its


[$2.5 million investment](https://news.kalshi.com/p/kalshi-everfi-new-york-stem-digital-literacy-partnership)


in STEM and digital literacy with Everfi.


As Kalshi continues to grow, the company remains committed to supporting organizations addressing critical community needs and creating opportunities for more Americans.
